title: Logarithmic spiral distance field (Nautilus growth rate)
description: r = s*e^(g*t): s is scale, g is the growth rate. The source documents g=0.1759 as the measured Nautilus growth rate and g=cot(t) for a constant-angle spiral.

parameters.name: growth
parameters.description: growth rate g; 0.1759 = measured Nautilus, cot(t) for angle t

constraints.why: source: 0<g<1 gives a counterclockwise spiral, -1<g<0 clockwise
source: 'distance field looks okay for g=.2, is bonkers for more extreme values' — the field stops being conservative

nomination.reason: a one-parameter growth law reproduces a whole shell family (Nautilus, ammonite, snail) — Atta's planned organic.seashell should be a spiral law, not a canned mesh

title: Lobed petal profile via phase-modulated radius, extruded and undulated
description: dist = (mag[x,y]-r) + cos(a*(90/5)): a polar lobing term added to the radius, extruded 1/8, Lipschitz-rescaled, then vertically undulated.

parameters.name: petal_diameter
parameters.description: diameter fed to the petals() helper

parameters.name: lobe_count
parameters.description: 90/5 in the phase term: 18 lobes around the profile

parameters.name: stem_twist
parameters.description: twist applied to the cylinder stem

constraints.why: non-integer lobe count breaks radial symmetry
undulation larger than the radius self-intersects

title: Phyllotaxis: circle spiral from rotate 0.05 / scale 0.9995 / step 0.1
description: Every successor draws a CIRCLE, rotates 0.05 deg and scales 0.9995 while advancing y 0.1 — the classic growth-spiral. Two rules mirror the rotation so the pattern alternates handedness.

constraints.why: the growth law only converges while each element is no larger than its parent
a zero step collapses the spiral into a straight column

title: Branch chain: loop-generated bar chains with stochastic branching
description: SHAPE4 loops 10 times with [[r .1 x 1]] to draw a slightly curved chain, and SHAPE3 branches into successors with a random side. This is the L-system 'turtle with noise' pattern expressed without an explicit turtle.

constraints.why: each loop iteration instantiates the successor; unbounded loops are the usual way a CFDG file explodes
beyond a half turn the chain coils onto itself

title: Porous coral: gyroid ∩ sphere with a plasma-warped domain
description: A gyroid (offset+rescaled) intersected with a sphere, then smoothed via a 'smooth N .intersection' blend. Six interactive sliders drive iteration count, amplitude, scale, speed, gyroid offset and blend width.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: slider[-1.5,2] — gyroid field offset; sets wall thickness

constraints.why: an offset approaching half the cell closes the gyroid and the coral becomes a solid ball
a blend wider than the clipping sphere erases the porous structure
declared slider max; each iteration costs a field evaluation

title: Mandelbulb with the four constants that define it
description: Spherical-power fractal: Bailout radius, iteration count, derivative bias and the power exponent. The field is a real distance estimator only when the derivative bias is tuned, which is why the file exposes it.

parameters.name: Iterations
parameters.description: fractal iterations; cost is linear, detail exponential

parameters.name: DerivativeBias
parameters.description: 'mermelada's tweak' — scales the distance estimate to stay conservative

parameters.name: Power
parameters.description: Mandelbulb exponent; 8 is the standard bulb

constraints.why: the estimate must under-shoot the true distance or sphere tracing overshoots and punches holes in the fractal
each iteration multiplies evaluation cost; 9 is the file default

title: Gyroid intersected with a torus: a porous donut
description: A gyroid sheet (shell 0.75, lipschitz 2) clipped by a huge bounding-box gate, bent, then smooth-intersected with a torus of major radius A and minor radius B.

constraints.why: a minor radius at or above the major radius turns the torus into a self-intersecting spindle and the intersection becomes solid
sheet thicker than half the tube fills the hole

title: Filament field: 1000-step loop with two-frequency size interference
description: Each spiral draws `steps`=1000 circles along y+=0.05 with r=(steps/360) per step, and modulates the radius by sin(2*pi*f1*i/steps)*sin(2*pi*f2*i/steps) where f1,f2 are random frequencies in [1,10000]. The result is a fibre bundle with beat patterns — a two-frequency interference law, not noise.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: circles per filament; also the angular divisor (r = steps/360)

parameters.name: freq_min
parameters.description: lower bound of the random frequencies f1,f2

parameters.name: freq_max
parameters.description: upper bound of the random frequencies

constraints.why: the rotation per step is steps/360, so tiny step counts spin the filament apart
below this the beat pattern aliases into pure noise

title: torus_z(ro, ri, center) — ring primitive by outer/inner radius
description: The torus parameterised by outer and inner radius rather than major/minor: (ro+ri)/2 is the major radius and (ro-ri)/2 the tube radius. Two independent wall-thickness parameters, which is what a printed ring needs.

constraints.why: at ri >= ro the tube radius goes non-positive and the ring collapses to a disc
tube wall under 0.4mm is below FDM resolution

title: ring(ro, ri) and polygon(r, n): annulus and n-gon as native fields
description: Two primitives worth taking seriously: ring(ro, ri, center) is a 2D annulus — a hole with no boolean — and polygon(r, n, center) is a regular n-gon whose side count is a parameter. Both avoid the CSG history that a difference-based construction carries.

constraints.why: at ri >= ro the annulus has no material
fewer than 3 sides is not a polygon; n=3 is the degenerate floor

title: Structure Synth — interrupted tradition (metadata only)
description: Grammar-based 3D structure generator (Tomasz Kaye / Mikael Hvidtfeldt Christensen lineage): production rules with transform primitives, a builder loop and a transformation stack, exported to OBJ. The direct 3D descendant of CFDG.

nomination.reason: 3D production system; the missing half of the grammar vein (CFDG is 2D only)

notes: Tier C / GPL lineage: metadata-only by policy. Licence evidence: n/a. No code may be taken; the value is the idea (see work/harvest/deep/NOTE.md §4).
